files.purpose: A @MainActor enum that is the whole marketing-capture harness: run under 'open -n -W "Droppy Code.app" --args --website-captures <folder>' (or --tour-captures), it never touches the real library, Keychain or defaults, instead seeding its own storage root and its own UserDefaults suite with fixed mock projects/threads/history, then puppeteering the real AppModel/ThreadRuntime through a fixed sequence of 'scenes' (editing, themes, diff popover, queue, palette, plans, question/approval, effort slider, model switcher, slash menu, quote) to produce PNG stills and an HEVC film via ScreenCaptureKit/AVFoundation for scripts/website_captures.py to cut. It also defines the Stage class (owns the backdrop window showing the real desktop picture plus the app's capture window, sizing/placement/popover-anchoring logic) and the Recorder/FilmRecorder classes (screenshot stills, 60fps screenshot-driven HEVC recording) that the scenes drive.
key_symbols: private/static scene funcs: blankScene, editingScene, themesScene, diffScene, queueScene, paletteScene, plansScene, questionScene, sliderScene, switcherScene, slashScene, quoteScene

final class Stage (wide/narrow sizes, captureRect, tourCaptureRect, screenRect(fromGlobal:), popoverFocus, setWindowHidden, tourRect(around:), setBackdrop, show(size:), ensureActive(), resize(to:), place(_:size:on:), holdPopover, presentPopover)
final class Recorder (still, writeSidecar, startFilm, stopFilm, finish, filter(), configuration(for:))
private final class FilmRecorder (append, finish, struct Frame)
calls_into: DroppyCode/Core/Support/CaptureRun.swift (outputDirectory, isTourRun, isEnabled, storageRoot, defaults, suiteName) - now called directly instead of through this file's own forwarding properties
AppModel (runtime(for:), settings, selectedThreadID, sidebar, thread(_:), project(_:), providers, isCommandPalettePresented, updateThread)

ThreadRuntime (rehearseTurn, rehearse(.reasoningDelta/.messageDelta/.toolStarted/.toolUpdated/.diff/.todos/.planCompleted/.question/.requestResolved/.approval/.reasoningCompleted/.messageCompleted), noteDiffChanged, clearDiffFocus, diffAnchor, isDiffVisible, enqueueFollowUp, removeFollowUp, followUps, draft)
EffortSliderCard, ModelList (UI views presented in Stage popovers)
AppKit: NSWindow, NSPopover, NSHostingView, NSScreen, NSApp, NSWorkspace.shared.desktopImageURL, Process (runs /bin/sh -c 'git init ... && git commit ...')
state_owned: WebsiteCaptures.modelChipAnchor / modelChipFrames / hydraMarkFrame / threadsButtonFrame / hydraPanelFrames - static mutable capture-only bookkeeping written by real UI views, read here to anchor popovers
side_effects: Deletes and recreates the capture storage root and <root>/threads and <output>/films directories
Wipes and rewrites the capture UserDefaults suite (CaptureRun.suiteName)
Writes library.json and per-thread history JSON under the capture storage root, and mock project files under repos/<name>/, including running 'git init'/'git commit' via Process for each mock project
Takes ScreenCaptureKit stills (PNG) and a 60fps screenshot-driven HEVC film (AVAssetWriter) of only this process's own windows
Creates/moves/orders real NSWindow (backdrop + capture window) and NSPopover instances, activates the app
Calls exit(0) to end the process when the run finishes or a 110s watchdog Task fires
platform_assumptions: ScreenCaptureKit (SCScreenshotManager/SCShareableContent/SCContentFilter/SCStreamConfiguration) is macOS-only and is what lets an unprivileged process capture only its own windows without Screen Recording permission
AVAssetWriter with the .hevc codec for the film master
Launch convention is macOS app-bundle argv via 'open -n -W ... --args --website-captures <folder>'
Assumes /bin/sh and a working 'git' binary on PATH for the mock repositories
persisted_fields: UserDefaults keys in the capture suite: appTheme, notifyWhenFinished, chimeWhenFinished, showReasoning, sidebarActivityView, defaultRuntimeMode, defaultProvider, lastProjectID, modelList (JSON [ModelPin]), and when isTourRun: hydraEnabled, hydraQueueHeads, hydraAlwaysHeads
ui_elements: None of its own besides BackdropWallpaper (a full-bleed desktop-picture image behind the capture window); every other visual is the real production UI (EffortSliderCard, ModelList, CommandPalette, TimelineRows/diff popover, approval/question sheets) driven through AppModel/ThreadRuntime
feature_notes: B2->B3 is a pure internal refactor, not a behavior change: the five nonisolated static properties WebsiteCaptures.outputDirectory/isTourRun/isEnabled/storageRoot/defaults (B2 lines 22-29), which only re-exported CaptureRun's own accessors under WebsiteCaptures's name, were deleted, and the six internal call sites in this file that used them were rewritten to call CaptureRun.* directly: log() B2:50->B3:42, prepare() guard B2:85->B3:77 (now 'guard let output = CaptureRun.outputDirectory, let root = CaptureRun.storageRoot, let defaults = CaptureRun.defaults else { return }', an explicit-assignment rewrite of the old shadowed-optional guard, same truth condition), the tour-defaults check B2:111->B3:103, the Hydra-mocks tour check B2:144->B3:136, and run(model:)'s dispatch/guard B2:304-305->B3:296-297. Net -8 lines (1122->1114), matching git diff --stat's '6 insertions(+), 14 deletions(-)' = 20 changed lines = the inventory's recorded churn of 20. A repo-wide grep for 'WebsiteCaptures.(outputDirectory|isTourRun|isEnabled|storageRoot|defaults)' across all tracked .swift files at B3 returns zero hits, confirming nothing else in the app depended on the deleted forwarding properties.

One caller outside this bundle, DroppyCode/App/AppDelegate.swift, was edited in the same commit in lockstep: its line 12 changed from 'if WebsiteCaptures.isEnabled {' (B2) to 'if CaptureRun.isEnabled {' (B3) - confirmed by diffing that file too, though AppDelegate.swift itself is outside bundle R3-04 so no report entry is made for it here.

This B3 change requires no C# port work: the file remains entirely unported by decision, and the refactor changes no externally observable behavior for anything the shipped Windows UI can reach.
